title: Notebook trim sweep — 6 agents >150L cap
rationale: Zone isolation: .claude/agents/notebooks/ has zero collision with any in-flight task (dev-mcp-server zone in 1967-02 QA + upcoming 1968c-P01/P03; agent-father zone in upcoming 1968c-P01/P02). claude-manager-helper is a dedicated notebook-hygiene specialist with no other concurrent claim.

Acceptance criteria are measurable and atomic: 6 line-count targets (wc -l ≤150), 6 archive-pointer presence checks (grep -c Archive:), 1 carry-over-preservation check, 1 commit-message reference check. No semantic ambiguity.

Pattern precedent established: TASK_1968a Phase 1 L-2 trimmed market-watcher.md from 158L → 65L successfully; same pattern reused here for the remaining 6 over-cap notebooks identified in the TASK_1967-04 QA side-finding.
Priority MED is correct: D5 guard will ALERT (not break) at next Tier-2 cycle if any notebook >160L. Proactive trim prevents alert-fatigue noise without urgency. Not a blocker for any other sprint.
Size S is correct: 6 markdown-only file edits + 6 archive file creations + 1 commit. No code, no tests, no infra. Estimate 2h is realistic.
NFR compliance: zero code change, zero DB change, zero Docker rebuild, BCTC freeze irrelevant (no BCTC paths). Fail-loud protocol non-applicable (manual file edits, no MCP calls).

out_of_scope: Any notebook ≤150L baseline (no preventive trim of compliant notebooks)
Any change to notebook-write SKILL hard cap (Sprint 1968a already set cap to 120L; this task harmonizes existing notebooks to ≤150L baseline, NOT to enforce a new cap)

ac_audit.ac_1_line_count_cap: PASS audit — 6 notebooks × wc -l verification is mechanically testable
ac_audit.ac_2_archive_pointer_line_3: PASS audit — grep pattern '^> Archive:' on line 3 is mechanically testable; pattern is consistent with market-watcher.md precedent
ac_audit.ac_3_carry_over_preserved: PASS audit — grep '## Carry-over' in live notebook vs archive ensures section preserved
ac_audit.ac_4_archives_created: PASS audit — 6 file existence checks at docs/archive/notebooks/<id>-2026-05-21.md
ac_audit.ac_5_commit_message_links_side_finding: PASS audit — git log -1 grep for 'TASK_1967-04 side_finding' or '1967-04' confirms link
ac_audit.ac_6_no_semantic_loss: PASS audit — archive file contains pre-trim content verbatim; sum(live_lines) + sum(archive_lines) ≥ sum(pre_trim_lines)

concurrent_tasks_zone_check: 1968c-P02 (agent-father, .claude/skills/ + .claude/agents/<7 cowork agent flows>) — POTENTIAL conflict on .claude/agents/news-scout.md + alert-commander.md frontmatter edits
parallel_safety.1968c_p02_conflict_resolution: 1968c-P02 updates agent .md files in .claude/agents/<agent>.md (e.g., always_load field). TASK_1967-12 updates notebook files in docs/agent-memory/notebooks/<agent>.md. DIFFERENT FILES, DIFFERENT DIRECTORIES. No file-level conflict. Both can execute in parallel.
